title: Length of the fixed table circuit
statement: Let $\kappa$ be a finite type, let $m,w\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $F$ assign a Boolean list to each element of $\kappa$ and each Boolean list. For every $\kappa_0\in\kappa$, the fixed table circuit associated with $\kappa_0$ has length equal to the maximum gadget width over $\kappa$, plus $w$.
